name: G-P (Globalization Partners)
description: G-P (Globalization Partners) is the recognized leader in global employment, providing a comprehensive platform to hire, manage, and pay employees and contractors in 180+ countries without setting up local entities.

itemListElement.name: G-P Authentication API
itemListElement.description: Securely verifies client identity and issues access tokens via OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant.

itemListElement.name: G-P EOR API
itemListElement.description: Provides capabilities for accessing and managing employee and employment data within the G-P Employer of Record product.

itemListElement.name: G-P Contractor API
itemListElement.description: API set for accessing and managing detailed Contractor information enabling companies to onboard, manage, and pay international contractors.
